categoriesWithoutSource.gap: No official keyless API for hotel pricing or airfare is registered.  nominatim can place-geocode but cannot price anything.
Wikimedia and Hacker News cover public attention, but every official creator-platform API is keyed (see KEYED_SOURCES_EXCLUDED). No verified creator-platform metric is claimed.
federal_register covers federal rulemaking, but the FEC API needs a key for most endpoints and state results are per-jurisdiction.  Partial coverage only.

The owner's master directory (https://buffedlizard55-lab.github.io/MasterSite/) publishes this category, but no source serving it is registered and no candidate endpoint has been confirmed by a recorded live read from this project.  Keyless game-metadata endpoints exist but are undocumented, and registering one without a recorded read would be an unverified claim.  No claim is made about this category.

keyedExcluded.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed) series observations
keyedExcluded.reason: Requires a free api_key query parameter.  Obtaining one is manual input, which this project refuses.  ecb_sdmx + worldbank + bls cover macro without a key.

keyedExcluded.name: NFL Game API (api.nfl.com)
keyedExcluded.reason: Requires an OAuth client id/secret issued on request.  Manual input; excluded.

keyedExcluded.name: Google Trends
keyedExcluded.reason: No official public API exists.  Third-party scrapers were rejected as unverifiable.  wikimedia_pageviews is the registered attention signal instead.

keyedExcluded.name: X / Twitter API
keyedExcluded.reason: All current tiers require a bearer token.  Manual input; excluded.

keyedExcluded.name: YouTube Data API v3
keyedExcluded.reason: Requires an API key even for the mostPopular chart.  Manual input; excluded.

keyedExcluded.name: TikTok / Instagram official APIs
keyedExcluded.reason: Both require an approved developer application.  This is why the creator/social interest category has no verified source; see ROADMAP.md.

sources.docsNote: Seed captures taken 2026-09-21; 5 payloads hashed into data/seed/. A seed capture is bootstrap evidence, not a probe read, so status stays 'registered' until msl.probe reads the endpoint itself.
sources.name: GitHub Search API — repositories
sources.notes: Used as the trending-repository signal.  GitHub publishes no trending *API*; /trending is HTML only, so the official Search API sorted by stars over a created:>= window is the reproducible substitute.

sources.docsNote: Seed capture 2026-09-21 hashed into data/seed/owner_repos.json. Status is set by the probe, not by this note.
sources.name: GitHub Repos API — owner corpus
sources.notes: Reads the owner's own published corpus so interest categories are derived from evidence, not assumed.

sources.docsNote: Registered 2026-09-22. One real capture is hashed into data/seed/ (browser-use/jev-ultrafast, 16,731 stars at capture time); status is set by the probe and by nothing else.
sources.name: GitHub Repos API — one repository
sources.notes: Per-repository read used by the deepening stage: it returns the counts the Search API does not (open issues, watching users, repository size, last push, primary language), so a tracked repository gets its own moving series instead of only a star count. It shares the field names github.repo[<name>].stars/.forks/.created with github_search, so two endpoints of the same operator can be compared on the same subject — see the contradiction rule in msl/ideas.py.

sources.docsNote: Registered 2026-09-22. Two real captures are hashed into data/seed/: an empty list (browser-use/jev-ultrafast) and a release object (ollama/ollama, tag v0.34.3-rc1). Status is set by the probe.
sources.name: GitHub Releases API — newest release
sources.notes: An empty array here is a fact, not a failure: it means the repository publishes no release, which is recorded as a negative claim. That is what lets the competition ask a question with a knowable answer — will the tag be different one cycle from now?

sources.name: MasterSite verified project catalog

sources.docsNote: Endpoint + Accept-header behaviour observed by direct read 2026-09-21 and recorded as IRR-002. Status set by the probe.
sources.name: npm Registry — package metadata
sources.notes: IRR-002: GET /-/package/{pkg}/dist-tags answers 200 for Accept: application/json but 406 Not Acceptable for Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json, which is the media type the registry documents for package metadata.  Observed 2026-09-21 from two hosts.  The probe therefore sends Accept: application/json and this is recorded, not papered over.
